protocol.encoder: Exact C4A Phikon caches; no new extraction or encoder training
protocol.LOCAL: Reuse exact C4A selected MLP predictions, three seeds, both tasks, primary and all four sensitivity folds
protocol.MEAN: Frozen C2 self-inclusive mean operator, selected geometry, hidden width/dropout and fixed sensitivity epochs
protocol.TRUE: Frozen C2 one-hop mean-aggregating GraphSAGE operator [x_i, mean_neighbors(x)] and selected geometry/configuration
protocol.MATCHED: Identical GraphSAGE model and training to TRUE with exact frozen C3 A6 distance-bin-preserving adjacency matrices, five graph seeds crossed with three training seeds
protocol.primary: Frozen C2 selected MEAN/SAGE parameters, frozen C1 optimizer and validation-MSE early stopping; no architecture or graph search. Lock all 42 primary model records before C4B test predictions.
protocol.sensitivity: All four held-out patients. Reuse audited C4A fold-training feature/target scalers. Frozen C2 fixed epoch counts, unchanged for true/matched graphs, with no held-out early stopping. This preserves the C3 spatial-model schedule for representation comparison.
protocol.comparability: Spatial model geometry, hidden width, dropout and training protocol are frozen C2/C3 choices. Local comparator is the requested C4A matched-budget MLP, so its selected width/epochs can differ from C3 local. Dimensions and parameter counts differ across encoders. Interpret the C3 comparison accordingly.

gate.PASS_SPATIAL_RECHECK: At least one panel has max(3, ceil(0.02 * panel size)) genes meeting every rule, plus all technical audits pass
gate.MIXED_SPATIAL_RECHECK: No PASS, but at least three genes in a panel have primary matched gain >=0.02, positive local gain and non-increasing primary MSE against both local/matched
gate.FAIL_TECHNICAL: Any graph, identity, frozen-source, replay or training-schedule audit fails

protocol.uncertainty: First average three training seeds within each matched graph, then report graph-seed sample SD across five frozen randomizations. Keep all 15 matched outcomes. No significance or population-level claim.
protocol.prior_outcomes_known: C0-C3 and C4A outcomes known; this is a gated sequential development recheck, not untouched confirmation
protocol.stop: No multiresolution, new graph radius, partial-ST input, interpretation or later checkpoint
